decide.title: Decide report
decide.description: choose what the platform does. Every open report about the same thing closes with this decision.
decide.noteHint: Kept with the decision. Only the platform sees it.

itemHidden.label: Item hidden
itemHidden.hint: The reported thing disappears from the portal and the business's site. The business still sees it in its panel.

companyHidden.label: Business hidden from portal
companyHidden.hint: The business stays reachable on its own site, but the portal no longer lists it.

companySuspended.label: Business suspended
companySuspended.hint: Nobody can sign in or work in the business, its sites go offline, and nothing is emailed on its behalf.

accountBanned.label: Account banned
accountBanned.hint: The account that wrote it can no longer sign in anywhere. Its open sessions end now.

itemHidden.title: Show again
itemHidden.description: the reported thing appears on public pages again.

companyHidden.title: Show business on portal again
companyHidden.description: the portal lists the business again, as its own settings say.

companySuspended.title: Lift suspension
companySuspended.description: the business's people can sign in again and its sites come back.

accountBanned.title: Lift ban
accountBanned.description: the account can sign in again.
